content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Porkbun: Content Creator & Video Producer Anywhere in the World 🇺🇸 United States of America Oregon Video Production, AI Content Creation, Animation, Video Editing, 3D Animation, Content Creation, Content Planning, Social Media Content, Videography, and Video Editing (Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere) All Other Remote Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0064/5136/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Oregon USA <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://porkbun.com">https://porkbun.com</a> </p> <p><strong>Content Creator &amp; Video Producer — Full-Time — $60,000/year + Benefits (Location: Remote, U.S.-based; Portland, Oregon preferred)</strong></p> <p>It's time to hire another amazing individual again. You could be the pick of the litter! This time we're hiring a Content Creator &amp; Video Producer to help Porkbun become the brand people stop scrolling for. Are you the kind of creator who instinctively knows why one video gets 5 million views while another gets 50? Do you get excited about writing hooks, telling stories, and making domain names — yes, domain names — unexpectedly entertaining? Then please read on and apply!</p> <p>Porkbun is a fully remote domain name registrar. We're looking to add a U.S.-based, full-time Content Creator &amp; Video Producer. We are hiring from within the United States, with a preference for candidates in or around Portland, Oregon, since IRL team collaboration is encouraged.</p> <p>From .com to .pizza to .plumbing, Porkbun sells more than 500 domain extensions directly to consumers. Our no-nonsense interface and super-affordable prices mean we're adding new customers at a fantastic rate. We've become the go-to registrar for tech-savvy individuals such as developers, while bargain-hunters are thrilled to learn that we offer incredible support despite our industry-low prices.</p> <p>We've spent years getting really good at buying attention. Now we want to build something more valuable: our own audience — and this role owns that. Porkbun has a uniquely committed and interested fan-base, and&nbsp; we know that our brand is well-positioned to share content that new and existing customers stop scrolling for.</p> <p>What you'll do:</p> <p>You'll own video content on organic channels from concept to publication — brainstorming ideas, writing scripts and hooks, filming (cameras, phones, mics, screen recordings), starring or creative casting, editing short- and long-form video, designing thumbnails and titles, publishing, and reading the numbers the next morning so the next one is better. One great idea shouldn't become one video: you'll turn a single concept into YouTube Shorts, TikToks, Reels, LinkedIn posts, newsletter and landing-page content, product-education videos, customer and founder interviews, and registry partner campaign assets. You’ll create both polished, educational knowledge base infotainment and scrappier organic social content that carries the brand’s unique personality.&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll work closely with the marketing team to publish and optimize content, collaborate with creators and influencers, and support partner campaigns. You'll continually explore and experiment with emerging AI tools for ideation, editing, animation, voiceovers, localization, and video production, helping us discover new ways to create better content more efficiently.</p> <p>Your work will span everything from short-form social videos and longer educational content to customer interviews, product explainers, behind-the-scenes stories, and creative campaign assets. As this is a brand-new role, you'll have the opportunity to grow our content strategy in a new direction. As you succeed, you will be positioned to lead and hire a team to start turning this giant personal responsibility list into a super team within the marketing department.</p> <p>Success won't be measured by views alone. We'll measure it by your ability to build our audience, strengthen the Porkbun brand, create content people genuinely enjoy, and help move our marketing forward.</p> <p>Important skills and experience:</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; A portfolio that shows your work and potential</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Strong instincts for brand stories and engaging content</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Comfort with the full pipeline: ideation, filming, editing, publishing, and analysis</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Fluency in both short-form social content and longer educational / infotainment formats</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; You edit “one more version” because you know it'll be better, and you know AI makes creative people more versatile, not less relevant</p> <p>Bonus points for experience with any of: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, Canva, motion graphics or animation, photography, podcast production, YouTube SEO, creator partnerships, marketing tech or SaaS, and AI tools like Runway, Veo, ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, or ElevenLabs.&nbsp;</p> <p>If the above describes you, or you can make a strong case for why we should hire you anyway, please follow the instructions below EXACTLY and respond accurately — failure to do so means we will filter out your application.</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Attach your resume as a .pdf and include links to your portfolio, website, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or anywhere else you've created content</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Address your email with the subject line “Content Creator &amp; Video Producer”</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Begin your email body by copying, pasting, and responding to the qualifying questions below. If you answer NO, we're sorry, but you are not eligible for the role:</p> <ul> <li>Are you based in the USA and eligible for employment (Yes/No)?</li> <li>Do you have a portfolio or body of content work you can share (Yes/No)?</li> </ul> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Even better than a written intro: record a quick video telling us why you'd be a great fit. We are, after all, hiring a creator.</p> <p>•&nbsp; &nbsp; Send that email to careers@porkbun.com</p> <p>Starting pay: $60,000/year + benefits. Applicants with multiple years of notable professional experience creating video and social content are eligible for a higher starting salary.</p> <p>This position offers full medical, dental, and vision benefits (single) starting after 90 days, and 50% medical insurance contribution for family or spousal benefits, and a Simple IRA plan with a matching 3% company contribution after the first year. It also includes paid parental leave, two weeks of paid vacation to start, paid federal holidays plus bonus days around Thanksgiving and Christmas, and a budget for creative tools and professional development.</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/porkbun-content-creator-video-producer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/porkbun-content-creator-video-producer</a></p> Tue, 04 Aug 2026 22:47:08 +0000 Thu, 03 Sep 2026 22:47:08 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/porkbun-content-creator-video-producer https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/porkbun-content-creator-video-producer Hook & Ladder: Web Developer Anywhere in the World Analytics, CMS Develo
